title: Version 0.56.0 - Prompt Caching and New Commands
description: Aider v0.56.0 enables prompt caching for Sonnet via OpenRouter and 8k output tokens for Sonnet via VertexAI and DeepSeek V2.5. New /report command to open browser with pre-populated GitHub Issue, new --chat-language switch for spoken language, and numerous bug fixes for corner case crashes. Aider wrote 56% of the code in this release.

title: Version 0.50.x - Major Feature Releases
description: Cursor released version 0.50.x in May 2025 with significant updates including simplified pricing, fully released Background Agent for all users, enhanced inline editing with refreshed interface, Max mode fully available to all users, new tab completion model, @folders support for referencing entire folders, and parallel task support in Background Agent.

title: Version 0.55.0 - GitHub Issue Integration and Improvements
description: Aider v0.55.0 added ability to submit GitHub issues pre-filled with uncaught exception info, new /settings command, startup QOL improvements including git repo sanity checks, inclusion of important devops files in repo map, and converted many error messages to warnings. Aider wrote 53% of the code in this release.
